<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_udc.CollectionItem</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description/>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>CollectionItem</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[class CollectionItem {
    static type = 'CollectionItem';
    static TABLE = 'sn_udc_collection_item';
    static M2M_TABLE = 'sn_udc_collection_item_m2m';
    static Column = {
        SysId: 'sys_id',
        User: 'user',
        Collection: 'collection',
        FileTable: 'file_table',
        File: 'file',
        Url: 'url',
        Label: 'label',
        TaxonomyType: 'taxonomy_type'
    };
    static M2MColumn = {
        Collection: 'collection',
        CollectionItem: 'collection_item'
    };

    static #FileType = {
        Apps: 'apps',
        Files: 'files',
        Lists: 'lists'
    };

    static #LOG = new Logger(CollectionItem.type);

    static getDuplicateCollectionItem(collectionItemDetails, userSysId, excludeSysId) {
        CollectionItem.#validateCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemDetails);

        if (gs.nil(userSysId)) {
            throw 'User sys id is not specified.';
        }

        const {
            file,
            fileTable,
            url
        } = collectionItemDetails;

        const isListBookmark = CollectionItem.#isListBookmark(fileTable, file, url);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.TABLE);
        gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.User, userSysId);

        if (isListBookmark) {
            // List bookmarks are scoped by url — unique (user, url) index enforces one record per user per URL
            gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.Url, url);
        } else {
            gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.FileTable, fileTable);
            gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.File, file);
        }

        if (excludeSysId) {
            gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.SysId, '!=', excludeSysId);
        }

        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();

        return gr;
    }

    static doesCollectionItemExist(collectionItemDetails, userSysId, excludeSysId) {
        const result = this.getDuplicateCollectionItem(collectionItemDetails, userSysId, excludeSysId);

        if (result === false)
            return false;

        return result.hasNext();
    }

    static doesCurrentUserHaveCollectionItem(collectionItemDetails, excludeSysId) {
        return CollectionItem.doesCollectionItemExist(collectionItemDetails, gs.getUserID(), excludeSysId);
    }

    static insertCollectionItemForCollection(collectionId, collectionItemDetails) {
        if (gs.nil(collectionId)) {
            throw 'Invalid collection item insertion. Collection sys id is not specified.';
        }

        CollectionItem.#validateCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemDetails);

        if (!Collection.isCollectionOwnedByCurrentUser(collectionId)) {
            throw 'Collection with sys_id: ' + collectionId + ' is invalid, does not exist, or you do not have access to it.';
        }
        const collectionItemSysId = CollectionItem.#getOrCreateCollectionItem(collectionItemDetails);

        if (CollectionItem.#doesM2mRecordExist(collectionId, collectionItemSysId)) {
            throw 'Collection item already exists in this collection.';
        }

        CollectionItem.#insertM2mRecord(collectionId, collectionItemSysId);

        return collectionItemSysId;
    }

    static deleteCollectionItem(collectionItemSysId) {
        if (gs.nil(collectionItemSysId)) {
            throw `Invalid collection item deletion. Collection item sys id: ${collectionItemSysId} specified is invalid.`;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.TABLE);

        if (!gr.get(collectionItemSysId)) {
            const message = `Collection item does not exists with sys id: ${collectionItemSysId}`
            this.#LOG.info(message)
            return
        }

        if (!gr.deleteRecord()) {
            throw 'Failed to delete collection item.'
        }

        return true;
    }

    static getCollectionItemsForUser(collectionId, options = {}) {
        return CollectionItem.getCollectionItemsByCollection(collectionId, {
            ...options,
            userSysId: gs.getUserID()
        });
    }

    static getCollectionItemsByCollection(collectionId, options = {}) {
        if (gs.nil(collectionId)) {
            throw 'Invalid collection items retrieval. Collection sys id is not specified.';
        }

        const {
            userSysId,
            type
        } = options;

        const collectionItemsGr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.TABLE);

        const m2mJoin = collectionItemsGr.addJoinQuery(
            CollectionItem.M2M_TABLE,
            CollectionItem.Column.SysId,
            CollectionItem.M2MColumn.CollectionItem
        );
        m2mJoin.addCondition(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.Collection, collectionId);

        collectionItemsGr.addNotNullQuery(CollectionItem.Column.FileTable);

        if (userSysId) {
            collectionItemsGr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.User, userSysId);
        }

        if (type === CollectionItem.#FileType.Apps) {
            collectionItemsGr.addNotNullQuery(CollectionItem.Column.File);
            collectionItemsGr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.FileTable, 'IN', Object.keys(UDCConstants.APP_TABLES).join(','));
        }

        if (type === CollectionItem.#FileType.Files) {
            collectionItemsGr.addNotNullQuery(CollectionItem.Column.File);
            collectionItemsGr.addQuery(CollectionItem.Column.FileTable, '!=', Object.keys(UDCConstants.APP_TABLES).join(','));
        }

        if (type === CollectionItem.#FileType.Lists) {
            collectionItemsGr.addNullQuery(CollectionItem.Column.File);
            collectionItemsGr.addNotNullQuery(CollectionItem.Column.Url);
        }

        collectionItemsGr.query();

        const processedResponse = CollectionItem.#processCollectionItems(collectionItemsGr);

        switch (type) {
            case CollectionItem.#FileType.Apps: {
                return {
                    apps: processedResponse.apps
                };
            }

            case CollectionItem.#FileType.Files: {
                return {
                    files: processedResponse.files
                };
            }

            case CollectionItem.#FileType.Lists: {
                // Historical quirk: list items are returned under the "files" key, not "lists".
                // Documented in current_sn_udc_collection_item_api_spec.json. Callers depend on
                // this shape — do not change without a coordinated consumer update.
                return {
                    files: processedResponse.lists
                };
            }

            default:
                return processedResponse;
        }
    }

    static getCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemSysId) {
        const collectionItemsGr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.TABLE);

        if (!collectionItemsGr.get(collectionItemSysId)) {
            throw `Collection item does not exists with sys id: ${collectionItemSysId}`;
        }

        // Get all taxonomy types grouped by table name
        const taxonomyTypes = UDCUtil.groupBy(FileTaxonomy.getTaxonomyTypesDetails(), 'table');

        return CollectionItem.#processCollectionItem(collectionItemsGr, taxonomyTypes);
    }

    static updateCollectionItem(collectionItemSysId, updatedCollectionItemDetails) {
        if (gs.nil(collectionItemSysId)) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid collection item. Collection item sys id: ${collectionItemSysId} specified is invalid.`);
        }

        var collectionItemGr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.TABLE);

        if (!collectionItemGr.get(collectionItemSysId)) {
            const message = `Collection item does not exist with sys id: ${collectionItemSysId}`;
            this.#LOG.info(message);
            return;
        }

        const {
            label
        } = updatedCollectionItemDetails;
        collectionItemGr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.Label, label);

        if (!collectionItemGr.update()) {
            throw 'Failed to rename collection item.';
        }

        return CollectionItem.getCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemSysId);

    }

    static addFileToCollections(collectionItemDetails, collectionSysIds) {
        CollectionItem.#validateCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemDetails);

        if (!Array.isArray(collectionSysIds) || collectionSysIds.length === 0) {
            throw 'collections must be a non-empty array.';
        }

        // Get all collections owned by current user
        const userCollectionsMap = Collection.getUserCollectionsMap();
        
        const validationMap = {};
        let hasValidCollection = false;

        for (let i = 0; i < collectionSysIds.length; i++) {
            const collectionId = collectionSysIds[i];
            
            if (!validationMap.hasOwnProperty(collectionId)) {
                // Check if it's default collection OR user owns the collection
                const isDefaultCollection = Collection.isDefaultCollection(collectionId);
                const isOwnedByUser = userCollectionsMap.hasOwnProperty(collectionId);
                const isValid = isDefaultCollection || isOwnedByUser;
                
                validationMap[collectionId] = isValid;
                if (isValid && !hasValidCollection) {
                    hasValidCollection = true;
                }
            }
        }

        if (!hasValidCollection) {
            throw 'At least one valid collection is required.';
        }

        const collectionItemSysId = CollectionItem.#getOrCreateCollectionItem(collectionItemDetails);

        const added = [];
        const failures = [];
        const uniqueCollectionIds = Object.keys(validationMap);

        for (let i = 0; i < uniqueCollectionIds.length; i++) {
            const collectionId = uniqueCollectionIds[i];
            const result = CollectionItem.#addItemToCollection(collectionId, collectionItemSysId, validationMap[collectionId]);
            
            if (result.success) {
                added.push(collectionId);
            } else {
                failures.push({
                    collectionSysId: collectionId,
                    operation: 'add',
                    message: result.error
                });
            }
        }

        if (failures.length > 0) {
            CollectionItem.#LOG.warn(`addFileToCollections: ${failures.length} collection(s) failed`);
        } else if (added.length > 0) {
            CollectionItem.#LOG.info(`addFileToCollections completed: added to ${added.length} collection(s)`);
        }

        // Fetch details only if at least one collection was added; WS operation guards on file && icon.
        const collectionItemDetailsResult = added.length > 0 
            ? CollectionItem.getCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemSysId) 
            : {};

        return {
            collectionItemSysId,
            file: collectionItemDetailsResult.file,
            icon: collectionItemDetailsResult.icon,
            added,
            failures
        };
    }

    static updateFileCollections(collectionItemDetails, addCollectionIds, removeCollectionIds) {
        CollectionItem.#validateCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemDetails);

        // Step 1: Remove duplicates
        const addSet = new Set(Array.isArray(addCollectionIds) ? addCollectionIds : []);
        const removeSet = new Set(Array.isArray(removeCollectionIds) ? removeCollectionIds : []);

        // Step 2: Remove common elements between add and remove
        const invalidDuplicates = [];
        const filteredAddArray = [];
        
        addSet.forEach(function(id) {
            if (removeSet.has(id)) {
                removeSet.delete(id);
                invalidDuplicates.push({
                    collectionSysId: id,
                    operation: 'add',
                    message: `Collection ${id} cannot be both added and removed.`
                });
            } else {
                filteredAddArray.push(id);
            }
        });

        // Validate at least one operation
        if (filteredAddArray.length === 0 && removeSet.size === 0) {
            throw 'At least one of add or remove must be specified.';
        }

        // Find existing collection item
        const existingItemSysId = CollectionItem.#findCollectionItemForUser(collectionItemDetails);

        if (!existingItemSysId) {
            throw 'File is not currently in any collection. Use POST to add file to collections.';
        }

        // Step 3: Remove unauthorized collections and build valid/invalid lists
        const userCollectionsMap = Collection.getUserCollectionsMap();
        
        const validAdd = [];
        const invalidAdd = [];
        const validRemove = [];
        const invalidRemove = [];

        // Filter add collections
        for (let i = 0; i < filteredAddArray.length; i++) {
            const collectionId = filteredAddArray[i];
            const isDefaultCollection = Collection.isDefaultCollection(collectionId);
            const isOwnedByUser = userCollectionsMap.hasOwnProperty(collectionId);
            const isValid = isDefaultCollection || isOwnedByUser;

            if (isValid) {
                validAdd.push(collectionId);
            } else {
                invalidAdd.push({
                    collectionSysId: collectionId,
                    operation: 'add',
                    message: `Collection with sys_id: ${collectionId} is invalid, does not exist, or you do not have access to it.`
                });
            }
        }

        // Filter remove collections
        const removeArray = Array.from(removeSet);
        for (let i = 0; i < removeArray.length; i++) {
            const collectionId = removeArray[i];
            const isDefaultCollection = Collection.isDefaultCollection(collectionId);
            const isOwnedByUser = userCollectionsMap.hasOwnProperty(collectionId);
            const isValid = isDefaultCollection || isOwnedByUser;

            if (isValid) {
                validRemove.push(collectionId);
            } else {
                invalidRemove.push({
                    collectionSysId: collectionId,
                    operation: 'remove',
                    message: `Collection with sys_id: ${collectionId} is invalid, does not exist, or you do not have access to it.`
                });
            }
        }

        const added = [];
        const removed = [];
        const failures = [].concat(invalidAdd, invalidRemove, invalidDuplicates);

        // Step 4: Execute add operations
        for (let i = 0; i < validAdd.length; i++) {
            const collectionId = validAdd[i];
            try {
                if (CollectionItem.#doesM2mRecordExist(collectionId, existingItemSysId)) {
                    failures.push({
                        collectionSysId: collectionId,
                        operation: 'add',
                        message: 'Collection item already exists in this collection.'
                    });
                    continue;
                }

                CollectionItem.#insertM2mRecord(collectionId, existingItemSysId);
                added.push(collectionId);
            } catch (error) {
                failures.push({
                    collectionSysId: collectionId,
                    operation: 'add',
                    message: error.toString()
                });
            }
        }

        // Step 5: Execute remove operations
        for (let i = 0; i < validRemove.length; i++) {
            const collectionId = validRemove[i];
            try {
                // Skip silently if not in collection
                if (!CollectionItem.#doesM2mRecordExist(collectionId, existingItemSysId)) {
                    continue;
                }

                CollectionItem.#deleteM2mRecord(collectionId, existingItemSysId);
                removed.push(collectionId);
            } catch (error) {
                failures.push({
                    collectionSysId: collectionId,
                    operation: 'remove',
                    message: error.toString()
                });
            }
        }

        // Step 6: Cleanup orphaned collection items if at least one M2M record was deleted
        if (removed.length > 0) {
            // Note: No transaction lock - concurrent add/remove races between M2M delete and this check are accepted as low-probability trade-off
            if (!CollectionItem.#hasM2mRecords(existingItemSysId)) {
                try {
                    CollectionItem.deleteCollectionItem(existingItemSysId);
                    CollectionItem.#LOG.info(`Deleted orphaned collection item: ${existingItemSysId}`);
                } catch (error) {
                    CollectionItem.#LOG.error(`Failed to delete orphaned collection item ${existingItemSysId}: ${error.toString()}`);
                }
            }
        }

        if (failures.length > 0) {
            CollectionItem.#LOG.warn(`updateFileCollections: ${failures.length} operation(s) failed`);
        } else if (added.length > 0 || removed.length > 0) {
            CollectionItem.#LOG.info(`updateFileCollections completed: ${added.length} added, ${removed.length} removed`);
        }

        return {
            added,
            removed,
            failures
        };
    }

    static #validateCollectionItemDetails(collectionItemDetails) {
        const {
            file,
            fileTable,
            label,
            url
        } = collectionItemDetails;

        const isListBookmark = CollectionItem.#isListBookmark(fileTable, file, url);
        if (isListBookmark) {
            if (gs.nil(label) || gs.nil(url) || gs.nil(fileTable) || !UDCUtil.isValidTable(fileTable)) {
                throw `Invalid collection item insertion. File table: ${fileTable}, url: ${url} or label: ${label} specified are missing or invalid`;
            }
        } else {
            if (gs.nil(file) || gs.nil(fileTable) || !UDCUtil.isValidRecord(fileTable, file)) {
                throw `Invalid collection item insertion. File table: ${fileTable} or file sys id: ${file} specified is invalid.`;
            }
        }
    }

    static #getAppCollectionItemDetails({
        fileObject,
        table,
        sysId
    }) {
        const taxonomy = new FileTaxonomy(table, sysId);
        return {
            icon: taxonomy.getIcon(),
            file: {
                table,
                sysId,
                label: taxonomy.getFileLabel() || gs.getMessage('(empty)'),
                name: taxonomy.getFileName(),
                type: taxonomy.getType(),
                typeSysId: taxonomy.getFileTaxonomySysId(),
                scope: FileTaxonomy.getArtifactScopeDetails(table, fileObject)
            }
        };
    }

    static #getInvalidArtifactDetails({
        fileObject,
        table,
        sysId
    }) {
        return FileTaxonomy.getFileDetails({
            fileTable: table,
            fileSysId: sysId
        });
    }

    static #getFileCollectionItemDetails({
        fileObject,
        table,
        sysId,
        taxonomyTypes
    }) {
        let fileDetails = {};
        const fileTableHandledTaxonomyTypes = taxonomyTypes[table];
        if (fileTableHandledTaxonomyTypes) { // metadata table has registered taxonomy types
            fileDetails = FileTaxonomy.getFileDetailsForRegisteredTaxonomyType(fileTableHandledTaxonomyTypes, sysId, table);
        } else {
            fileDetails = FileTaxonomy.getFileDetailsForUnRegisteredTaxonomyType(sysId, table);
        }
        // Add scope information to file objects
        if (fileDetails && fileDetails.file) {
            fileDetails.file.scope = FileTaxonomy.getArtifactScopeDetails(table, fileObject);
        }

        return fileDetails;
    }

    static #getListCollectionItemDetails({
        url,
        label,
        table,
        sysId
    }) {
        return {
            icon: 'list-outline',
            file: {
                url,
                label,
                table
            }
        };
    }

    static #processCollectionItem(collectionItemGr, taxonomyTypes) {
        const collectionItemSysId = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.SysId);
        const table = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.FileTable);
        const sysId = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.File);
        const label = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.Label);
        const url = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.Url);

        let fileDetails = null;
        if (CollectionItem.#isListBookmark(table, sysId, url)) {
            fileDetails = CollectionItem.#getListCollectionItemDetails({
                url,
                label,
                table
            });
        } else {
            const fileObject = FileTaxonomy.getFileObjectRecord(table, sysId);
            if (!UDCUtil.isValidGlideRecord(fileObject)) {
                fileDetails = CollectionItem.#getInvalidArtifactDetails({
                    fileObject,
                    table,
                    sysId
                });
            } else if (UDCUtil.isAppRecord(table)) {
                fileDetails = CollectionItem.#getAppCollectionItemDetails({
                    fileObject,
                    table,
                    sysId
                });
            } else {
                fileDetails = CollectionItem.#getFileCollectionItemDetails({
                    fileObject,
                    table,
                    sysId,
                    taxonomyTypes
                })
            }
            if (label && fileDetails.file)
                fileDetails.file.label = label;
        }

        if (fileDetails.error) {
            const {
                code
            } = fileDetails.error;

            // Handle deleted bookmarked artifact
            if (table && sysId && code === UDCConstants.ERROR_CODES.NOT_FOUND) {
                return CollectionItem.#getJSONForDeletedArtifact(collectionItemGr, fileDetails);
            }

            // Log and skip errored record
            const errorMessage = `Unable to fetch file taxonomy details for file table: ${table} with sys id: ${sysId}`;
            this.#LOG.error(errorMessage, fileDetails.error);
            return null;
        }

        const {
            file,
            icon
        } = fileDetails;

        return {
            file,
            icon,
            collectionItemSysId
        };
    }

    static #getJSONForDeletedArtifact(collectionItemGr, fileDetails) {
        const collectionItemSysId = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.SysId);
        const table = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.FileTable);
        const sysId = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.File);
        const label = collectionItemGr.getValue(CollectionItem.Column.Label);
        const taxonomyGr = collectionItemGr[CollectionItem.Column.TaxonomyType].getRefRecord();

        if (UDCUtil.isValidGlideRecord(taxonomyGr)) {
            return {
                file: {
                    table,
                    sysId,
                    label,
                    type: taxonomyGr.getDisplayValue(FileTaxonomy.Column.Label) || FileTaxonomy.getTableLabel(table),
                    typeSysId: taxonomyGr.getUniqueValue()
                },
                icon: taxonomyGr.getDisplayValue(FileTaxonomy.Column.Icon) || FileTaxonomy.getFallBackIcon(table),
                collectionItemSysId
            }
        }

        return {
            file: {
                table,
                sysId,
                label,
                type: fileDetails.type,
                typeSysId: ''
            },
            icon: FileTaxonomy.getFallBackIcon(table),
            collectionItemSysId
        };
    }

    static #processCollectionItems(collectionItemsGr) {
        // Get all taxonomy types grouped by table name
        const taxonomyTypes = UDCUtil.groupBy(FileTaxonomy.getTaxonomyTypesDetails(), 'table');
        const apps = [];
        const files = [];
        const lists = [];

        while (collectionItemsGr.next()) {
            const collectionItemDetails = CollectionItem.#processCollectionItem(collectionItemsGr, taxonomyTypes);

            if (!collectionItemDetails) {
                continue;
            }

            const {
                file: {
                    sysId,
                    table,
                    url
                }
            } = collectionItemDetails;
            const targetToPushTo = CollectionItem.#isListBookmark(table, sysId, url) ? lists : UDCUtil.isAppRecord(table) ? apps : files;
            targetToPushTo.push(collectionItemDetails);
        }

        return {
            apps,
            files,
            lists
        };
    }

    static #isListBookmark(fileTable, fileSysId, url) {
        return gs.nil(fileSysId) && fileTable && url;
    }

    static #getTaxonomyRecordForArtifact(fileTable, fileSysId) {
        const taxonomy = new FileTaxonomy(fileTable, fileSysId);
        return taxonomy;
    }

    static #findCollectionItemForUser(collectionItemDetails) {
        const gr = CollectionItem.getDuplicateCollectionItem(collectionItemDetails, gs.getUserID(), null);
        return (gr !== false && gr.next()) ? gr.getUniqueValue() : null;
    }

    static #getOrCreateCollectionItem(collectionItemDetails) {
        const existingItemSysId = CollectionItem.#findCollectionItemForUser(collectionItemDetails);
        
        if (existingItemSysId) {
            return existingItemSysId;
        }
        
        return CollectionItem.#insertCollectionItemRecord(collectionItemDetails);
    }

    static #addItemToCollection(collectionId, collectionItemSysId, isValidCollection) {
        try {
            if (!isValidCollection) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    error: `Collection with sys_id: ${collectionId} is invalid, does not exist, or you do not have access to it.`
                };
            }

            if (CollectionItem.#doesM2mRecordExist(collectionId, collectionItemSysId)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    error: 'Collection item already exists in this collection.'
                };
            }

            CollectionItem.#insertM2mRecord(collectionId, collectionItemSysId);
            
            return { success: true };
        } catch (error) {
            return {
                success: false,
                error: error.toString()
            };
        }
    }

    static #insertCollectionItemRecord(collectionItemDetails) {
        const { file, fileTable, url, label } = collectionItemDetails;
        const isListBookmark = CollectionItem.#isListBookmark(fileTable, file, url);

        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.TABLE);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.FileTable, fileTable);
        gr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.Url, url || '');
        gr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.User, gs.getUserID());

        if (isListBookmark) {
            gr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.Label, label);
        } else {
            const taxonomy = CollectionItem.#getTaxonomyRecordForArtifact(fileTable, file);
            gr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.File, file);
            gr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.TaxonomyType, taxonomy.getFileTaxonomySysId());
            gr.setValue(CollectionItem.Column.Label, label || taxonomy.getFileLabel() || gs.getMessage('(empty)'));
        }

        const recordSysId = gr.insert();

        if (!recordSysId) {
            throw 'Invalid collection item insertion.';
        }

        return recordSysId;
    }

    static #doesM2mRecordExist(collectionSysId, collectionItemSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.M2M_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.Collection, collectionSysId);
        gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.CollectionItem, collectionItemSysId);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        return gr.hasNext();
    }

    static #insertM2mRecord(collectionSysId, collectionItemSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.M2M_TABLE);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.Collection, collectionSysId);
        gr.setValue(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.CollectionItem, collectionItemSysId);
        gr.setWorkflow(false);
        
        const sysId = gr.insert();

        if (!sysId) {
            throw `Failed to create collection membership for collection: ${collectionSysId}, item: ${collectionItemSysId}`;
        }

        return sysId;
    }

    static #deleteM2mRecord(collectionSysId, collectionItemSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.M2M_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.Collection, collectionSysId);
        gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.CollectionItem, collectionItemSysId);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.next()) {
            if (!gr.deleteRecord()) {
                throw `Failed to remove collection membership for collection: ${collectionSysId}, item: ${collectionItemSysId}`;
            }
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    static #hasM2mRecords(collectionItemSysId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(CollectionItem.M2M_TABLE);
        gr.addQuery(CollectionItem.M2MColumn.CollectionItem, collectionItemSysId);
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        return gr.hasNext();
    }
}]]></script>
